As yields decrease, investors are keen to secure these advantageous rates ahead of the US midterm elections, aware of their potential market implications.
headline: Oil slide hands India's 10-year bond its best day since early April

author: Kumar Gaurav
description: Reliance Industries has approved plans to raise up to Rs 15,000 crore through non-convertible debentures via private placement. The fundraising announcement came with the company's Q2 earnings where it reported a 41% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore.
headline: Reliance Industries announces fundraising, to raise Rs 15,000 crore through NCDs

author: ET Spotlight
description: Market corrections can influence portfolios differently depending on their size and the investor's timeline. Investors with larger portfolios need a careful approach to risk management amid market fluctuations. Those with long-term aspirations should keep funds for short-term needs separate from their growth capital. This tactic guarantees that financial commitments are fulfilled even during market downturns.
headline: The ₹1 Crore Portfolio Problem: When Your Money Grows, Your Mistakes Get More Expensive

author: Reuters
description: US Treasuries experienced a notable rise as technology stock selloffs caused a shift towards safer investments. The yield on the benchmark 10-year note had its largest monthly drop in nearly three years. Earnings reports from Amazon and Intel negatively impacted investor confidence amid rising AI costs. Expectations for a December interest rate hike remain high after a recent Federal Reserve meeting.
headline: US bonds rally, sending yields to biggest monthly decline since 2023

author: Veer Sharma
description: Gold has fallen more than 30% from its January record high, with rising oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of further Fed rate hikes adding to pressure. Analysts remain cautious about a near-term recovery, even as major banks retain bullish forecasts for 2027.
headline: Explained: Why gold investors should tone down expectations as yellow metal plunges to a 1-year low

author: Reuters
description: Gold prices experienced a minor uptick in early trading across Asia; however, they linger near a one-year low. Persistent worries about inflation are bolstering expectations for an impending Federal Reserve rate increase this year. The recent drop in tech stocks has placed additional strain on bullion prices, prompting a sell-off in safe-haven investments. Buyers in major Asian markets, especially India and China, remain hesitant amid expectations of further price declines.
headline: Gold lingers near one-year low as Fed hike expectations firm

author: Veer Sharma
description: Gold and silver prices experienced mixed movements on MCX ahead of Diwali due to inflation fears. Rising inflation triggered expectations for a potential US Federal Reserve interest rate hike later this year. Federal Reserve officials have suggested further interest rate increases are needed to address inflation. Silver futures gained while gold futures saw a decline in the domestic market.
headline: Gold price prediction today: Gold down for 3rd consecutive day. Check outlook for November 2

author: Veer Sharma
description: Crude oil price : Oil prices have plummeted dramatically, impacting Brent and WTI crude significantly. As Iranian and Qatari officials engage in talks to mitigate tensions from the US-Israeli conflict regarding Iran, the situation is further aggravated by security threats and oil tanker assaults in the Strait of Hormuz. Experts warn of ongoing price instability post-US midterm elections, creating an unpredictable environment for global energy supply chains and market responses.
headline: Oil Price Today (November 2): Crude oil falls to $111 as Iran-Qatar talks continue to end war. What are ex

author: Reuters
description: Oil prices witnessed a decline of more than 1% as Iranian and Qatari diplomats engaged in discussions regarding the US-Israeli conflict. Brent crude futures fell to $111.84 per barrel, alongside a drop in US West Texas Intermediate crude. Analysts express optimism about potential advancements in these negotiations, which have eased short-term pricing worries.
headline: Oil slips more than 1% as talks continue on ending Iran war

author: ET CONTRIBUTORS
description: Silver has plunged more than 58% from its February record high of nearly $120 an ounce to around $50, as profit-booking, weaker industrial demand and shifting macroeconomic conditions weigh on prices. Geojits Hareesh V explains what drove the rally, why it unravelled and what could shape silvers recovery.
headline: Silver loses more than half its value from record high: What went wrong and will it recover?

author: ET Spotlight
description: Quarterly numbers tell you what happened. But they do not always tell you why it happened. In commercial vehicles, demand can change because of many reasons: Interest rates, freight movement, regulation, vehicle utilisation, or simply the age of the fleet. This story looks at the factors that matter most for Ashok Leyland and uses the numbers to show how each one affects the business.
headline: Ashok Leyland: A stronger balance sheet inside a business that will always remain cyclical

author: ET Spotlight
description: Ashok Leyland's June-quarter has an unusual contradiction. The company sold 48,763 commercial vehicles, its highest-ever first-quarter volume, and revenue from operations rose 10.43% to Rs. 9,634 crore. Yet, the operating EBITDA was Rs. 970 crore, almost the same as a year earlier. The Q1 FY 27 result must, therefore, be understood not in terms of greater demand, but in terms of why the record volumes and revenue did not lead to an increase in operating earnings.
headline: Ashok Leyland just had a record June quarter. So why did the margin fall a full point?

author: ET Spotlight
description: Ashok Leyland sold more commercial vehicles in FY26 than in any year since it was founded, earned its highest-ever profit, and closed with Rs. 5,899 crore of net cash. Where does the company go from here? What strategies will it adopt? A close reading of the 340-page annual report, along with the company's year-end call and the June-quarter filing, provides the answers.
headline: Ashok Leyland's best year in its history, and what the annual report says about holding on to it

author: PTI
description: DEE Development Engineers Limited announced a framework agreement with a domestic engineering contractor for the nuclear power sector. This collaboration aims to strengthen its presence in various nuclear power projects across India. The focus will include comprehensive engineering support like design services, budgetary offers, and sourcing of essential components. Indian nuclear energy ambitions are driving the need for reliable engineering expertise and strict quality standards.
headline: DEE Development Engineers signs framework pact with domestic EPC firm for nuclear power sector

author: ET Spotlight
description: There is, at this point, an apparent contradiction at work in the Indian commercial vehicles space. One: FY 2026 was the best of the last seven years. A tax cut saw prices of trucks drop by about 10%, releasing pent-up replacement demand in a fleet with an average age of about 10 years. Two: Although the sector's second-largest truck maker sold a record number of vehicles in the June quarter, adding 10%  to revenue, the benefits did not flow in. Rising material costs swallowed the operating leverage.
headline: India's commercial vehicle market just had its best year in seven. Then the June quarter arrived, and marg

author: Debaroti Adhikary
description: Binance is investigating a reported security breach estimated to have caused $6.3 billion in losses, with North Korea-linked hackers suspected by TRM Labs. The exchange says user funds are safe and has pledged to cover all losses.
headline: Biggest crypto heist in history: How Binance’s $6 billion hack rattled markets and what it means for inves

author: Reuters
description: Binance customers pulled $3.64 billion, or 2.1% of its assets, as the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange resumed service after a security breach linked to North Korea saw $6.3 billion stolen from the platform last week.
headline: Binance sees outflows stabilising as exchange returns online after $6.3 billion heist

author: Debaroti Adhikary
description: Bitcoin fell more than 4% to a six-week low below $78,000, while Ether and BNB also slumped after a reported $6.3 billion security breach at Binance rattled crypto markets. Analysts flagged key support levels and advised investors against panic selling or aggressive dip-buying, favouring staggered entries and smaller positions.
headline: Bitcoin hits 6-week low, drops below $78,000 as Binance’s $6 billion hack rattles crypto markets. What sho

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin and Ethereum fell as hotter-than-expected US inflation data, rising Treasury yields, and weaker global equities weighed on crypto sentiment. Despite the sell-off, spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs recorded fresh inflows, while nearly $944 million in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours.
headline: Bitcoin holds near $81,200, Ethereum at $2,415 as institutional inflows cushion global market pressure

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: In the past 24 hours, Bitcoin and Ethereum were down 1.6% and 1.5% respectively. Among the major altcoins, BNB, Dogecoin, Solana, Hyperliquid, Dogecoin and Cardano corrected upto 3.1% whereas Tron was up 0.3%.
headline: Bitcoin holds near $84,000, Ethereum moves towards $2,700 as buyers remain active

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin traded around $86,000 as expectations of easier US monetary policy supported crypto sentiment. Analysts said weak jobs data reduced rate-hike expectations, while mixed ETF flows, elevated bond yields and resistance near $87,000 kept gains in check and encouraged cautious positioning.
headline: Bitcoin holds near $86,000 as weak US jobs data lowers October Fed rate hike expectations

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: In recent developments, Bitcoin has dropped to roughly $80,685, while Ethereum hovers around $2,370 due to various market influences. Major altcoins such as XRP and Dogecoin have also experienced dips, some decreasing by 2.2%. A noticeable decline in institutional interest is evident, with substantial outflows from Bitcoin and Ether ETFs. Both Bitcoin and Ethereum are facing challenges sustaining their momentum amidst the market's volatility.
headline: Bitcoin hovers near $80,000 and Ethereum at $2,370 as macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows weigh

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin has regained momentum after breaking above key resistance levels, supported by stronger spot ETF inflows, institutional demand and a broader risk-on mood. Analysts expect the rally to face resistance near $89,500, while rising futures open interest and elevated leverage could increase volatility if fresh buying fails to keep pace.
headline: Bitcoin jumps nearly 5% to cross $85,000 as strong ETF inflows and institutional buying boost crypto momen

author: Debaroti Adhikary
description: A reported $6 billion crypto heist at Binance has rattled investors and revived concerns about cryptocurrency risks. Binance said its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineers laptop, which may have enabled unauthorised withdrawals. The FBI blamed North Korea for the attack, while Binance said it would cover the losses.
headline: Bitcoin rattled by biggest crypto heist in history! Why Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger hated cryptocurr

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin rebounded to around $84,000 after briefly crossing $86,000, while Ethereum traded near $2,688. Bitcoin gained 3.6% weekly, supported by positive ETF flows and reduced uncertainty after the US Federal Reserves September policy decision, though markets remain in consolidation overall.
headline: Bitcoin rebounds strongly this week, trades near $84,000 after climbing above $86,000. Here is what expert

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000 and Ethereum approached $2,620 as crypto markets recovered despite a hawkish Federal Reserve stance and uncertainty around the CLARITY Act. Improving risk sentiment, cooling oil prices and short liquidations supported the rebound, while ETF outflows, elevated rates and regulatory uncertainty remain key factors shaping the market outlook.
headline: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin reclaimed $82,500 on Saturday after hitting a nearly three-week low earlier in the week, as improved ETF flows supported sentiment. Experts flagged institutional outflows, US-Iran tensions and AI-related security concerns as risks. Bitcoin and Ethereum remained down over the week, while derivatives data showed substantial liquidations across crypto markets.
headline: Bitcoin reclaims $82,500 as improved ETF flows lift market sentiment. Here is what experts say

author: Debaroti Adhikary
description: Bitcoin has surged around 750% since Warren Buffett called it “rat poison squared” in 2018, despite his longstanding concerns about cryptocurrencies. The digital asset has since hit record highs above $126,000, driven by growing institutional and investor interest, before correcting sharply. Heres why Buffett remained cautious about Bitcoin.
headline: Bitcoin skyrocketed 750% since Warren Buffett called it 'rat poison' in 2018. Why was he cautious?

author: Surbhi Khanna
description: Bitcoin slipped near $79,000 as investors awaited the Federal Reserves policy decision. ETF outflows, macroeconomic uncertainty and selling pressure weakened sentiment, while traders monitored $78,000 support, inflation data and institutional demand for potential market direction.
headline: Bitcoin trades near $79,000 as Fed rate uncertainty, selling pressure weigh on crypto markets

author: Kumar Gaurav
description: CoinSwitch achieved profitability based on Adjusted EBITDA for FY26, with revenue growth of 150%. The company's revenue reached Rs 324.19 crore, leading to an Adjusted EBITDA margin increase to 27%. Operating costs increased by 37%, contributing to improved operating leverage. The platform focused on expanding its active user base and educating newcomers about crypto. CoinSwitch now serves over 2 crore users and supports more than 450 digital assets.
headline: CoinSwitch swings to profitability in FY26 as crypto platform’s revenue climbs 150% to Rs 324 crore

author: Kumar Gaurav
description: Real-world asset tokenization is shifting from issuance toward utility, with RWA AUM reaching $34.18 billion by September 15, 2026. Binance Research highlights rising utilization, as liquidity, lending and collateral applications increasingly determine whether tokenized assets become financially active on-chain.
headline: Crypto outlook: Why RWA utilization may matter more than issuance, Binance Research explains

author: Bloomberg
description: Despite a decline in crypto trading activities, there is a rising interest in traditional assets among investors. Open interest in real-world asset contracts has increased to $9 billion, claiming 14% of total volume. The transition marks a significant change in the derivatives markets as crypto inroads are being utilized for traditional trading. This shift indicates a maturation of the digital asset space, making it more accessible to mainstream investors.
headline: Crypto’s leverage machine finds new life beyond Bitcoin bets

author: Bloomberg
description: Traders are actively engaging in memecoin and stock token swaps on Robinhood's platform, blurring traditional investment lines. The SEC has allowed temporary tokenized stock trades, reflecting a growing retail trend. Companies like AMC have expressed concerns over tokens trading without their involvement. As these trades evolve, stock prices may become detached from their underlying assets. This shift signifies a potential change in how risk is perceived by day traders.
headline: Robinhood stock tokens turbocharge a new era of meme trading

author: ET CONTRIBUTORS
description: Ahead of the $16 billion Bitcoin options expiry on September 25, low price volatility reflects dealer hedging and positive gamma rather than low risk. As Deribit contracts reset, market structure shifts, making spot liquidity, macro trends, and fresh positioning crucial for Bitcoin's next directional move.
headline: What Bitcoin’s $16 billion options expiry means for investors

author: PTI
description: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has announced plans to develop a housing project in Pune. This initiative will generate an estimated revenue of Rs 1,650 crore through a Joint Development Agreement. The project, located in Hinjewadi, spans 5.62 acres and features a total saleable area of approximately 1.25 million sq ft. Birla Estates, a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate, will oversee the project development.
headline: Aditya Birla Real Estate eyes Rs 1,650 cr revenue from new project in Pune

author: Reuters
description: AI data center construction projects, particularly near Dallas/Fort Worth and Washington, DC, are generating new demand for warehouse space and helped send rents higher in the third quarter, real estate services company JLL said on Tuesday.
headline: AI data center projects boost US warehouse demand and rents, real estate company JLL says

author: PTI
description: Brigade Enterprises Ltd has forged a partnership with Hyatt Hotels Corporation to launch two new hotels in Bengaluru, including the Hyatt Regency Bengaluru at Brigade Global Park and an additional property on Whitefield-Kadugodi Road. With a combined total of 600 rooms, this collaboration further enhances Brigade's commitment to developing hospitality within mixed-use spaces, leveraging Bengaluru's strong business travel market for growth.
headline: Brigade Enterprises signs Hyatt Hotels to manage two hotels in Bengaluru

author: Kailash Babar
description: SEBI amended REIT regulations to revise unitholder voting thresholds, introduce exit options for dissenting investors during specified sponsor exits, permit depository receipts against REIT units and modify common infrastructure definitions, with implications for governance, investor protection and market access.
headline: ET EXPLAINER: What do the new REIT regulation amendments mean for investors?

author: PTI
description: In the first three quarters of 2026, home registrations in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area fell to 41,309, highlighting a year-on-year decline. Yet, there was an observable trend towards mid-sized and larger apartments. Specifically, September recorded 4,845 registrations, down from the previous year, with North Kolkata dominating 36% of the total shares. This data reveals a growing preference for spacious and practical living spaces among buyers.
headline: Kolkata home registrations dip 12 per cent in Jan-Sep; larger flats gain share

author: PTI
description: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd has seen impressive financial growth, with sales bookings skyrocketing by 66% to reach Rs 1,988 crore this year. The second quarter alone saw bookings rise to Rs 1,063 crore from Rs 752 crore in the previous year. While tax expenses increased, net profit for the September quarter stood at Rs 16.34 crore, and total income surged to Rs 104.
headline: Mahindra Lifespace Developers pre-sales rise 66% to nearly Rs 2,000 cr in Apr-Sep

author: PTI
description: According to a Savills report, India's branded residences market is predicted to grow by 126% over the next six years, with 25 ultra-luxury projects expected by 2032, driven by the rising demand from high-net-worth individuals.
headline: Number of branded housing projects in India set to jump over 2-fold in 6 years: Savills

author: PTI
description: Raymond Realty has announced that it has secured Rs 210 crore from ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund. This financial investment will be used for a redevelopment project in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The investment will be made through Ten X Realty West Ltd, a subsidiary of Raymond Realty. The collaboration aims to enhance capital efficiency and expedite project timelines.
headline: Raymond Realty raises Rs 210 cr from ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund

author: Reuters
description: India's market regulator has unveiled a new framework enabling foreign investors to invest in REITs and InvITs, aiming to boost foreign capital in these sectors. To issue depositary receipts, REITs and InvITs must gain approvals from both local and international exchanges, requiring a minimum of 75% consent from unitholders for any fresh offerings. Currently, established REITs and InvITs in India are already open to foreign investments under certain regulations.
headline: Sebi issues rules for depositary receipts on REITs, InvITs units

author: PTI
description: In a significant move to adhere to Sebi's minimum public shareholding regulations, Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd announced that promoter Anand Kamalnayan Pandit plans to sell 2.38 crore shares. This transaction is scheduled for November 3-4, with the shares priced at Rs 240 each, despite the company's current share price of Rs 245.90. Presently, promoters own 79.87 percent of the company.
headline: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty promoters to sell 2.38 cr shares via OFS

author: PTI
description: TVS ILP has leased 80,000 square feet in Visakhapatnam to ATC Tires for a new warehouse. This facility will support domestic distribution and export operations for Yokohama passenger car tires. The development is expected to create local employment opportunities in the region. Visakhapatnam's strategic location provides significant advantages for various industries seeking to grow. This partnership is key in enhancing operational efficiencies and logistics infrastructure for ATC Tires.
headline: TVS ILP leases 80k sq ft at Visakhapatnam park in Andhra to Yokohoma group

author: Reuters
description: British annual house prices rose at their weakest annual pace since March in August, according to official data published on Wednesday that also showed growth in average
headline: UK annual house prices rise at weakest pace since March, ONS says

author: Himadri Buch
description: Stefan Bollinger highlights the potential risk of an AI bubble affecting global markets significantly. He notes that India's equity valuation correction is healthy, maintaining the country's growth story. Investors are increasingly diversifying their portfolios with a focus on hedge funds and private equity. The Fed's decision on rates remains uncertain, though high inflation complicates matters. Rising yields in Japan are likely to attract domestic investors back to their markets.
headline: Banks are safe; AI bubble is the risk for global markets: Julius Baer CEO Stefan Bollinger

author: Veer Sharma
description: Nifty could extend its recovery towards 23,500 if it decisively breaks above the 23,150–23,200 resistance zone, says SBI Securities' Sudeep Shah. He also shares his outlook on IT, midcap and smallcap indices, sector trends and six stocks, including TVS Motor, Coforge and ICICI Bank, ahead of Diwali.
headline: F&O Talk: Big break above 23,200 can open doors for 23,500 for Nifty; Sudeep Shah picks 6 stocks ahead of

author: Nikhil Agarwal
description: Anand James, Chief Market Strategist at Geojit Investments, says the recovery still looks like a narrow largecap-led bounce, even as the 18% surge in Nifty IT points to the early stages of a possible leadership cycle. He also assesses Swiggys rebound prospects and names his top stock ideas for the week.
headline: Nifty’s comeback or a largecap trap? Anand James decodes breadth, IT and Swiggy

author: Kshitij Anand
description: In this edition of ETMarkets PMS Talk, we speak with Vaibhav Agarwal, Founder & CIO, Accelt Asset Management LLP, about how his teams bottom-up stock-picking approach identifies businesses capable of delivering sustained earnings growth. He explains why smallcaps offer opportunities among companies growing earnings at 25–30%, how the GMCV framework — Growth, Management, Capital Efficiency and Valuation — helps separate potential compounders from value traps, and why paying the right price matters even when a business has a compelling growth story.
headline: PMS Talk: AI, defence and electronics manufacturing are the next growth engines, says Vaibhav Agarwal

author: Nikhil Agarwal
description: With investors caught between low-risk arbitrage funds and high-risk equity, PMS and AIF products, AlphaGrep Mutual Fund is positioning its Eminence Hybrid Long-Short Fund as a middle-ground allocation. The strategy combines market neutral and relative value approaches, special situations, options, arbitrage and fixed income to pursue diversified returns without relying entirely on the direction of the equity market.
headline: SIFs offer a middle ground between arbitrage and equity risk: AlphaGrep MF CEO Bhautik Ambani

author: Reuters
description: Major currencies remained steady as traders evaluated the upcoming US midterm elections and significant economic data. Bitcoin and Ether experienced losses after a major security breach at Binance, raising investor concerns. The euro hovered near a 17-month low following Fitch's revision of France's outlook to negative. Hedge funds reportedly faced significant losses that could limit market reactions to election results.
headline: Dollar rangebound ahead of US midterms; bitcoin reels from crypto heist

author: Reuters
description: The yen remains steady as the Bank of Japan gears up for its expected interest rate policy decision. The dollar has slipped lower, responding to falling Treasury yields against a backdrop of diminished AI stocks. Despite high energy prices, other central banks are holding their interest rates steady. This month, the dollar index reflects slight gains, highlighting its ongoing resilience amidst exchange rate volatility.
headline: Yen steady before BOJ, AI jitters drive Treasury rally, weigh on dollar

author: Ritesh Presswala
description: EAAA India Alternatives experienced a quiet entrance into the market, debuting at a slight premium over its IPO price. The IPO, valued at Rs 1,200 crore, involved completely an offer for sale by the promoter without any new equity shares being issued. Consequently, no funds will benefit the company directly.
headline: EAAA India Alternatives shares list at less than 1% premium on BSE, NSE

author: Ritesh Presswala
description: Glass Wall Systems IPO is witnessing strong investor demand, with 8.22x overall subscription by Day 2 and a 36% GMP indicating positive listing expectations. The Rs 427.89 crore issue closes September 10, 2026. Proceeds will fund a glass processing unit, while FY26 revenue and profit grew strongly. Analysts recommend subscribing for long-term growth.
headline: Glass Wall Systems IPO Day 3: Issue subscribed over 82x, GMP at 36%; Check details

author: PTI
description: Carlsberg has filed an updated draft red herring prospectus for its potential IPO in India. Pernod Ricard continues to prepare for its proposed listing while awaiting board approval for its Indian business. Coca-Cola is exploring a potential IPO for its Indian bottling operations, emphasizing the value in the domestic market. These developments indicate a growing interest in public listings among multinational beverage companies in India.
headline: Global beverage majors advance India IPO plans, from DRHP filing to board approval

author: Akash Podishetti
description: HDB Financial Services IPO: The IPO comprises a fresh equity sale of Rs 2,500 crore and an offer-for-sale component, allowing existing shareholders to divest their holdings. HDB Financial Services, a major NBFC, focuses on retail and commercial customers with a diversified portfolio of financial products and services.
headline: HDFC Bank approves IPO of HDB Financial Services with fresh equity sale of Rs 2,500 crore

author: Akash Podishetti
description: Indias IPO market is set for a quiet week, with just one fresh issue worth Rs 56.68 crore opening for subscription and no mainboard launches. Vedant Poly Fabs will be the only new IPO, while 13 companies are expected to list. The slowdown follows Octobers blockbuster Rs 30,188 crore Jio Platforms IPO, which was subscribed over 22 times.
headline: IPO Calendar: Primary market cools after Jio frenzy, but 13 listings lined up

author: Meghna Chadha
description: With Jio Platforms’ mega IPO in focus, how does Mukesh Ambani’s telecom giant compare with Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea? We break down key metrics, including subscriber base, customer additions, ARPU, churn, EBITDA margins, data consumption and revenue market share, and look at how potential tariff hikes and the IPO could shape the sector’s growth prospects.
headline: Jio vs Airtel vs Voda Idea: Comparing ARPU, Margins, Subscribers & More

author: Ritesh Presswala
description: Coal India subsidiary South Eastern Coalfields has filed its draft papers with SEBI for an IPO comprising an offer for sale of up to 66.81 crore shares. One of Indias largest coal producers, SECL reported higher revenue and profit and plans to list on the BSE and NSE.
headline: South Eastern Coalfields files DRHP with SEBI for IPO; Coal India to offload 66.8 crore shares

author: Ritesh Presswala
description: Tempsens Instruments (India) IPO opened for subscription on August 20, with a reported 73% grey market premium indicating strong investor interest. The Rs 650-crore issue, open until August 24, includes a Rs 95-crore fresh issue and a Rs 555-crore offer for sale. Investors are watching the IPO closely for potential listing gains.
headline: Tempsens Instruments IPO opens for bidding; GMP at 73%. Should you subscribe or skip?

author: Ritesh Presswala
description: Vedant Poly Fabs Rs 56.68-crore IPO opens for subscription today on the NSE SME platform, with a 16% grey market premium indicating a potentially positive listing. The company plans to use the proceeds for working capital, debt repayment and manufacturing expansion.
headline: Vedant Poly Fabs SME IPO opens today; GMP at 16%, check key details

author: ET Online
description: HDFC Bank’s stock is down nearly 29% from its peak, and new CEO Anup Bagchi faces a tough turnaround test. Can he revive growth, improve margins and unlock the value of the HDFC merger? We break down the challenges, growth outlook and what investors should watch next.Follow ET Markets for more market insights.
headline: A banking giant, a battered stock: Can HDFC Bank’s new chief turn the tide?

author: Akash Podishetti
description: ITC Q2 Results: ITC Ltd reported an 18.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter on Monday as a sharp fall in earnings from its cigarette business weighed on overall profitability despite strong growth in its FMCG, agriculture and paper businesses.
headline: ITC Q2 Results: Profit falls 18% to Rs 4,229 crore, revenue rises 5%

author: Kumar Gaurav
description: Marico reported a 31% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 550 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 3,897 crore. EBITDA increased 27%, margins expanded to 18.2%, and management expects double-digit growth during FY27.
headline: Marico Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 31% YoY to Rs 550 crore, revenue rises 12%

author: Anumeha Chaturvedi
description: Oyo parent PRISM reported a 35% YoY rise in Q1FY27 revenue to Rs 2,814 crore, while net profit grew 17% to Rs 353 crore. Gross Booking Value increased 30% to Rs 9,600 crore and EBITDA rose 24% to Rs 760 crore. Founder Ritesh Agarwal highlighted growth across hotels and vacation homes, technology investments and AI-led operational efficiencies.
headline: Oyo parent PRISM clocks PAT of Rs 353 crore in Q1, up 17% YoY, revenue jumps 35%

author: Reuters
description: Devyani International, the parent company of KFC and Pizza Hut in India, has recorded a significant reduction in losses during its second quarter. For the third straight quarter, same-store sales for KFC increased by 4.4%. With revenues climbing by 10.4% to 15.19 billion rupees and expenses only rising 8.3%, Chairman Ravi Jaipuria emphasized the ongoing challenges posed by inflation and increasing interest rates.
headline: Pizza Hut, KFC India operator's Q2 loss naarrows sharply on strong same-store sales growth

author: Kumar Gaurav
description: State Bank of India will announce Q2FY27 results on November 3, with brokerages forecasting 11-13% NII growth and up to 25.2% profit growth. Investors will track margins, loan growth, deposits, credit costs and asset quality.
headline: SBI Q2 Results Preview: PAT may rise up to 25% YoY; NII, margins, deposit growth in focus

author: Snehal Mergu
description: Sun Pharmaceutical achieved notable revenue growth in the September quarter, driven by strong performance in India and specialty medicines. The company anticipates medium-term growth from therapies like Ilumya and ongoing innovative projects. Although profitability was affected by acquisition and litigation costs, the domestic market share increased to 8.6% from last year. R&D investments are expected to rise in the second half of FY27 as development accelerates.
headline: Sun Pharma’s specialty portfolio, Organon deal to drive growth

author: ET Online
description: “For me, business is puja, and every puja ends with prasad.”A heart felt moment at Jio's historic stock market debut! Anant Ambani invokes his grandfather's dreams, thanks PM Modi & calls the NSE bell a temple bell.Watch the full video #jio #listing #dalalstreet #NSE #BSE #anantambani #akashambani #relianceindustries
headline: ‘Jio Mere Laal’: Anant Ambani’s emotional words leave Mukesh Ambani teary-eyed

author: Economic Times
description: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 Highlights: The Indian stock market rallied on Monday, with Sensex and Nifty jumping nearly 2% each as falling oil prices, strong earnings by heavyweights including Reliance Industries and other factors strengthened the bulls of Dalal Street.
headline: Stock Market Highlights | Closing Bell: Sensex rockets 1,233 pts, Nifty soars above 23,400; Tata Steel, Coal India jump up to 5%

author: Economic Times
description: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights: The Indian stock market rebounded on Monday, with Sensex and Nifty staging a sharp recovery of nearly 2% from the early losses and snapping a four-day losing streak that wiped off massive sums of investor wealth.

description: The US midterm elections could reshape the political landscape and influence market sentiment. Democrats are widely expected to win the House of Representatives, while control of the Senate remains uncertain. The outcome could affect AI regulation, fiscal spending and sectors such as defence and healthcare. (Source: Reuters) ​US midterm elections take centre stage
headline: 5 key global market themes investors will watch this week

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Chinas stock market edged higher after reports that regulators would discuss measures to support capital markets. However, concerns over state-backed Zhuhai Huafa Groups liquidity continued to weigh on related stocks and bond funds.
headline: China stocks edge higher as reports of market support lift sentiment

description: Goldman Sachs has revised its outlook on the Bank of England's interest rates, now predicting a possible quarter-point rise in November's monetary policy meeting. This would be the first increase since 2023, influenced by climbing energy costs and robust economic growth. Although immediate policy shifts are unlikely, the Bank will vigilantly observe inflation risks, maintaining rates at 4.25% through mid-next year.
headline: Goldman Sachs expects Bank of England to raise rates again in February

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Goldman Sachs raised its oil price forecasts amid mounting geopolitical risks and potential Gulf supply disruptions. The bank warned Brent crude could reach $140 per barrel in 2027 under a prolonged supply shock scenario. Shipping attacks, infrastructure damage and Middle East tensions could sustain elevated oil prices and market volatility.
headline: Goldman Sachs raises oil price forecasts, warns Brent could hit $140 in 2027

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Japanese government bond yields were mixed on Monday, with the 10-year benchmark holding steady at 2.77%, while the 20-year and 30-year yields rose. Investors assessed global interest rate trends ahead of a series of government debt auctions, including a 10-year bond sale on Thursday, followed by 30-year and five-year auctions later this month.
headline: Japan bond yields edge higher ahead of key JGB auctions; 10-year yield holds at 2.77%

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Japans Nikkei slipped as Kioxia plunged 13.29% following a disappointing earnings outlook, while banking stocks also weakened. Gains in Tokyo Electron and Panasonic, supported by upbeat profit forecasts and AI-related demand, limited losses. Broader investor sentiment remained cautious following Wall Streets technology selloff and concerns over AI investment sustainability.
headline: Japan's Nikkei slips as Kioxia tumbles 13%; Tokyo Electron, Panasonic limit losses

author: Reuters
description: Marvell Technology is poised to acquire Lumentum in a groundbreaking all-stock transaction worth $115 billion. This strategic acquisition is intended to position Marvell more competitively against Broadcom in the rapidly growing AI sector. With this expansion, Marvell anticipates boosting its optical components production to satisfy the escalating demand in data transfer spurred by AI innovations in data centers.
headline: Marvell to buy Lumentum in $115 billion deal in AI data-center bet

author: Reuters
description: Meta is reportedly looking to raise at least $20 billion through a cross-border bond offering to fund its expanding AI infrastructure. The potential debt sale follows its planned $97.5 billion equity fundraising, highlighting how major technology companies are increasingly tapping debt and equity markets to finance their artificial intelligence ambitions.
headline: Meta eyes at least $20 billion from potential bond offerings, Bloomberg News reports

author: Reuters
description: Oracle has announced its ambitious plan to generate $20 billion through bond and share sales, focusing on both corporate needs and essential infrastructure development. The raised funds are earmarked for advancing initiatives in AI and cloud computing, projecting substantial growth soon. This fundraising will also assist with capital expenses, debt repayment, acquisitions, and share buybacks. Despite a 3.
headline: Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bonds and stock sales

author: Anupam Nagar
description: South Korean shares rose after early losses due to strong export data that improved investor sentiment. Exports from South Korea nearly doubled in October, marking their highest increase in over 50 years. Analysts indicated that this performance might lead to upward revisions in corporate earnings forecasts. However, factory activity in South Korea expanded at its slowest pace in eight months.
headline: South Korean shares rebound as strong exports spur dip-buying

author: Reuters
description: US manufacturing activity accelerated in October, with the ISM manufacturing PMI rising to 55.5 from 54.5 in September, beating Reuters-polled economists' expectations. Strong consumer and AI-related business spending supported growth, but factory input prices remained elevated at 75.2, reinforcing concerns that US inflation could stay above the Federal Reserve's 2% target.
headline: US manufacturing strengthens in October, input prices stay high

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Wall Street faces a pivotal week as US midterm elections, major corporate earnings and October jobs data test investor sentiment. Recent AI-led tech selloffs have heightened concerns over infrastructure spending and returns. Apple, AMD and Palantir results, alongside regulatory uncertainty and economic signals, could determine market direction and volatility.
headline: US Midterm elections, Apple earnings, jobs data to test Wall Street after AI rout

author: Reuters
description: In the US, stock futures surged as investors prepare for the upcoming midterm elections and await earnings announcements. Major tech players, such as Alphabet and SpaceX, enjoyed premarket boosts. Estee Lauder's optimistic sales and profit outlook added to market enthusiasm. However, caution prevails as investors weigh the potential consequences of congressional control post-elections. Additionally, falling oil prices eased worries over supply issues in the Middle East.
headline: US stock futures rise as AI stocks catch their breath; midterms in focus

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Chinas yuan traded near a more than four-year high against the US dollar, supported by expectations of further appreciation. Investors tracked the central banks currency guidance, policy measures and potential market implications of the US midterm elections.
headline: Yuan hovers near four-year high as investors eye US midterm elections

author: ETMarkets.com
description: Anthropic reported a 1,100% surge in third quarter revenue to $17 billion ahead of its planned IPO later this month. However, the AI company also disclosed a $23.3 billion net loss and nearly $895 billion in spending commitments, raising questions about AI infrastructure costs and investor appetite for its proposed listing.
headline: Anthropic revenue jumps 1,100% ahead of IPO as AI spending commitments near $900 billion

author: Agencies
description: Apple will announce its fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 results on Monday, November 2, after the US market closes. Investors will assess early demand for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup, the performance of its Services business and the company's outlook for the holiday quarter. The earnings announcement will also mark the first results presentation under new CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook on September 1. (Sources: Yahoo Finance, BigGo Finance) Apple Q4 earnings: iPhone 18 sales in spotlight
headline: Apple Q4 earnings: 5 key things investors will watch

author: Anupam Nagar
description: Major US technology companies sharply reduced dividends and share buybacks as record AI infrastructure spending pushed their combined free cash flow into deficit. The shift raises concerns about shareholder returns and places greater pressure on Big Tech to deliver profit growth from its AI investments.
headline: Big tech share buybacks plunge 83% as AI spending hits cash flows

author: Anupam Nagar
description: The Bank of Japan has strengthened signals of a possible December rate hike as inflation remains above target. However, uncertainty over Japans neutral interest rate and the impact of higher borrowing costs leaves the central banks longer-term tightening path unclear.
headline: BOJ signals December rate hike, but path beyond 1.5% remains uncertain

author: ETMarkets.com
description: A San Francisco Fed study warns the current strong El Niño could drive US inflation up by 1 percentage point in 2027, despite temporarily boosting jobs. With inflation already above the 2% target, the climate shock adds further pressure on the Fed to raise interest rates.
headline: El Nino could add to US inflation pressures in 2027, San Francisco Fed paper warns

author: Anupam Nagar
description: French bond yields remained steady despite Fitch downgrading the country's outlook to negative, as investors weighed fiscal concerns and political uncertainty against easing energy prices and developments in the Middle East.
headline: Global Market: French bond yields hold steady despite Fitch downgrade warning

headline: Nasdaq Outlook: Is the worst over for AI-fuelled tech stocks?

description: Foreign investors have significantly reduced their holdings in nearly 70% of India's leading companies in recent years. This decrease in foreign investments mirrors diminished expectations for growth in India relative to other global markets. Although some companies experience slight increases in foreign ownership, they still remain at historical lows.

The aircraft went down at around 12:50 p.m. ET, leaving a large crater and burning debris. The private jet had departed Texas and was heading to the Bahamas, according to the Federal Aviation Administration. Local authorities urged residents to stay away as emergency crews responded. The FAA and National Transportation Safety Board have launched an investigation into the cause of the crash.
headline: Florida Plane Crash: All Nine Killed As Learjet 60 Crashes In Residential Area Near Mar-a-Lago

author: Livemint
description: Italy’s government is planning a 26% capital gains levy on individuals who move their tax residence abroad and hold assets exceeding €800,000, according to the draft 2027 budget. The measure would apply to people who have been Italian tax residents for six of the previous ten years, potentially affecting wealthy expats who relocated under the flat-tax regime. Italy attracted about 3,600 millionaires in 2025, but the welcome has grown more expensive as the flat tax was raised.
headline: If Wealthy People Want To Leave Italy, They Will Soon Need To Pay A Whopping Tax!
